intro.title: Request Deduplication
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React application that fetches data from a mock API. You will learn how request deduplication prevents sending the same API call multiple times when it's already in progress, improving performance. The core concept involves using a caching mechanism to track ongoing requests. You will implement this using React hooks and TypeScript to manage state and ensure type safety. By the end, you'll understand how deduplication optimizes network usage in real-world applications.
intro.usecase: Request deduplication is essential in modern web applications where multiple components might request the same data simultaneously. In a dashboard displaying analytics, different widgets (charts, tables, KPIs) often need the same user or sales data—deduplication prevents redundant API calls. When users interact with filters or search inputs that trigger frequent requests, deduplication ensures efficient data fetching without overloading the server. This pattern is crucial in e-commerce product listings, social media feeds, and real-time collaboration tools where multiple UI elements depend on shared data sources.
